description: Paste a base32 secret to get real RFC 6238 TOTP codes with a live countdown, plus a verify mode.

faqs.a: HMAC-SHA1 with a 30-second time step and dynamic truncation — exactly per RFC 6238/4226.
Yes — enter a code to check it against the current, previous, and next 30-second window.
Secrets often include spaces or lowercase letters; both are accepted and ignored/normalized.
The secret never leaves your browser — but for real accounts, prefer your phone's authenticator app.
faqs.q: Is it safe to paste my real secret?

howto: The current 6-digit code appears with a countdown ring.
Use verify mode to check a code someone gives you.
title: TOTP Generator
